text:
Yes, a 20,000 mAh power bank is generally fine in carry-on. It must go in your carry-on, never your checked bag.

**Why it passes:** The FAA limits spare lithium-ion batteries and power banks to 100 Wh each. To convert, divide mAh by 1000 to get Ah, then multiply by the voltage. A typical 20,000 mAh bank runs at about 3.7 V, so that's 20 Ah × 3.7 V ≈ 74 Wh, well under the limit ([FAA: Airline Passengers and Batteries](https://www.faa.gov/hazmat/packsafe/airline-passengers-and-batteries)).

**Rules to follow:**
- **Carry-on only.** Spare batteries and power banks are prohibited in checked baggage. If your carry-on gets gate-checked, take the power bank out and keep it with you ([FAA PackSafe: Lithium Batteries](https://www.faa.gov/hazmat/packsafe/more_info/?hazmat=7)).
- **Protect the terminals.** Keep it in its retail packaging, a pouch, or a case, or tape over exposed terminals, so it can't short-circuit.
- **Don't bring a damaged or recalled one.** Those aren't allowed in carry-on or checked bags.
- **Airlines may be stricter.** The FAA notes that many airlines limit how many power banks you can carry, regardless of capacity, so check your carrier's policy ([IATA guidance](https://www.iata.org/en/youandiata/travelers/batteries/) says the same).
- **Check the label.** Newer banks print the Wh rating on the case. If yours is 20,000 mAh but runs at a higher voltage, do the math. Anything over 100 Wh needs airline approval (101-160 Wh, max two), and over 160 Wh isn't allowed.

**If you're shopping for one:** The Baseus Blade H1 (20,000 mAh, 100 W, about 74 Wh) is listed as carry-on legal at $89.99: [Baseus Blade H1](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah). That listing comes from a retailer-affiliated page (an affiliate link), and it doesn't itself cover TSA or FAA rules, so rely on the FAA sources above for the rules. For a lighter option, the 10,000 mAh Baseus PicoGo AM52 (about 37 Wh) is $53.99 with code AM52: [Baseus PicoGo AM52](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w).
